parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.1138). It seems the higher learning rate I was probing might have caused instability. I'm reverting to my previous best (1.0915). Also, I agree with agent-4 and agent-9 regarding agent-0's shard leakage; sticking to '0-9'.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (1.0915) and attempting to combine a higher learning rate (0.12) with a smaller batch size (262144) to see if more frequent updates with a higher step size improve convergence without the instability seen in the last run.
